description: E211 s1. What a person reads when a sample project from the public store is offered, prepared, started and restored (project_gateway/sample_store.py CODES): one closed key each, one sentence each. `{sample}` is the sample's name as a person reads it; no sentence carries a code, a field name, a path, a count or an identifier. `limits` (E212 s1) are what a person reads when a per-person limit on public-store fetches refuses (HTTP 429): `{limit}` is the limit's value and `{reset}` the time (UTC) it resets. `labels` are the readable licence words a card shows, `kinds` the names of what a sample holds. Why a sample's own description is not offered is E211 s0's words (vocabulary/v1/sample-index-words.json); why the store's index is refused is E212 s0's (vocabulary/v1/public-store-words.json).

reasons.no-store: This deployment does not offer samples from the public store, so {sample} is not offered here.
reasons.store-unreachable: The public store of samples could not be reached, so {sample} and the other samples from it are not offered now. Try again later.
reasons.store-index-invalid: The list of what the public store holds is not valid, so {sample} and the other samples from it are not offered now.
reasons.sample-index-unreadable: The list of samples in the public store could not be read completely, so {sample} and the other samples from it are not offered now. Try again in a minute.
reasons.bundle-not-in-store: The data of {sample} are not where the list of samples says they are, so it is not offered.
reasons.not-offered: {sample} is not offered now, so nothing was created.
reasons.bundle-unreadable: The data of {sample} could not be downloaded, so nothing was created. Try again later.
reasons.bundle-size: The data of {sample} arrived with the wrong size, so they were deleted and nothing was created.
reasons.bundle-digest: The data of {sample} do not match their published checksum, so they were deleted and nothing was created.
reasons.bundle-manifest-differs: What the data of {sample} hold is not what was published for it, so they were deleted and nothing was created.
reasons.not-owner: Only an owner of the organisation can create a project with {sample}, so nothing was created.
reasons.not-administrator: Only the project's administrator can fill it with {sample}, so nothing was added.
reasons.handle-expired: The download of {sample} is no longer held, so nothing was added. Press again to download it again.
reasons.not-organization-project: {sample} was downloaded for another organisation than the one this project belongs to, so nothing was added.
reasons.command-conflict: This request was already used for something other than {sample}, so nothing was added.
reasons.restore-running: {sample} is already being added to this project, so a second one was not started.
reasons.entry-changed: {sample} changed in the public store after it was downloaded, so nothing was added. Press again to use the new one.
reasons.restore-unavailable: This deployment cannot add {sample} to a project now, so nothing was added.
reasons.key-allowance-full: You hold as many project access keys as you may, so {sample} could not be added. Remove one of your access keys and press again.
reasons.restore-incomplete: Not everything in {sample} was added to this project. Press again to add the rest; what is already here is kept.
reasons.restore-refused: Adding {sample} stopped part way, so this project may hold part of it. Press again to finish it.
reasons.restore-cannot-run: This deployment cannot run the restore of {sample}, so this project may hold nothing of it yet.
reasons.restore-failed: Adding {sample} failed, so this project may hold part of it. Press again to finish it.
reasons.restore-timeout: Adding {sample} took too long and was stopped, so this project may hold part of it. Press again to finish it.
reasons.restore-interrupted: The service restarted while {sample} was being added, so this project may hold part of it. Press again to finish it.
reasons.operation-unknown: There is no addition of {sample} of yours with that name in this project.
reasons.dataset-unbound: The public store does not list {sample} under exactly one dataset, so its licence and credits cannot be kept with it and nothing was added.

states.restoring: {sample} is being added to this project.

limits.fetch-busy: You are already fetching {limit} public datasets. Try again after {reset}.
limits.creations-today: You have created {limit} sample projects today. You can create more after {reset}.
limits.bytes-today: Fetching this sample would pass today's limit of {limit} from the public store. You can fetch it after {reset}.

labels.publisher-terms: Under the publisher's own terms, kept as written
